cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, Syosset, New York, 1962; Sotheby Parke Bernet Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 3913, lot no. 188, 28 October 1976; Private collection, Cape Girardeau, Missouri, 1976; Kennedy Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, 1982; Private collection, Palm Beach, Florida, 1983 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. On backing: In pencil by O'Keeffe, 'Pink Spotted Lily' 36" [not verified]. Sotheby Parke Bernet 1976 entry indicates, OK ☆ {star} on backing [not verified]. Abiquiú Notebooks orients work both as here and upside down. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Pink Spotted Lily

description: A lily's white, rippling petals curve outward from its green center. Pink dots cover the petals, and green stamens project from within the flower. Dark green leaves frame the lily, which blooms against a softly shaded, bluish-gray background.
title: Pink Spotted Lily
